definitions.explanation: A state of mutual goodwill and cooperation, especially between nations, organizations, or groups.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}の{友好|ゆうこう}{関係|かんけい}を{深|ふか}めたい。
examples.english: We want to deepen the friendly relations between the two countries.

examples.japanese: {友好|ゆうこう}{条約|じょうやく}が{結|むす}ばれた。
{友好|ゆうこう}{的|てき}な{態度|たいど}で{接|せっ}した。
examples.english: I treated them with a friendly attitude.

notes:
USAGE: {友好|ゆうこう} is typically used in formal contexts, especially in diplomacy and international relations. For personal friendships, {友情|ゆうじょう} is more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{友好|ゆうこう}{関係|かんけい} (friendly relations)
・{友好|ゆうこう}{条約|じょうやく} (friendship treaty)
・{友好|ゆうこう}{都市|とし} (sister city)
・{友好|ゆうこう}{的|てき} (friendly - な-adjective)

NOTE: Do not confuse with {有効|ゆうこう} (valid, effective), which has the same reading.
